title: os package publish sends the manifest's listing tags (cloud now stores them), and drops or maps the top-level tagline
body:
Filing gate ①: the objectstack half that #27348 asks for ("Then the objectstack half (a new card in that repository, filed by whoever answers 1 and 2)"). Questions 1 and 2 were answered on #27348 (comment 6485953428). The cloud half landed as objectstack-ai/cloud#3361 (merged 2026-10-29 02:41Z as a32781f, Fixes cloud#3360). Filed by `repo:cloud` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #27348 · follows #27325

## 维护者速读

cloud 的发布接口现在会校验并保存作者声明的 `tags`，市场可以按标签搜索了。但 `os package publish` 还没把清单里的 `tags` 发出去。这张卡让 CLI 发送 `tags`，同时把 #27325 临时警告的措辞改对：

- `publisher` 和 `isStarter` 由平台决定，作者写了也不生效。警告应该这么说，而不是说「暂未携带」。
- 顶层 `tagline` 云端不存。CLI 在没有 description 时把它当 description 发，有 description 时不再发送。

## Facts

- **Cloud, main a32781f.** `POST /api/v1/cloud/packages` reads `body.tags` on create and on re-publish.
  - The shape check is `CreatePackageRequestSchema.shape.tags`.
  - Each tag is trimmed, empty tags are dropped, and repeats are removed. The bounds are at most 20 tags of at most 64 characters each.
  - A malformed value gets a 400 `INVALID_FIELD` or `VALUE_TOO_LONG`, with `details.field: 'tags'`, and nothing is written.
  - When the body has no `tags`, the column is left alone. `[]` clears it.
- **Cloud: `publisher`.** The control plane decides it alone (`package-publish.ts`, around :843-844). It never reads the body.
- **Cloud: `isStarter`.** It is honoured only for a first-party service-mode seed. An author's value is ignored.
- **Cloud: top-level `tagline`.** It is not read and has no column. The seat ruled on cloud#3360 that it gets none, because `description` is the short listing text (512 characters).
- **CLI, objectstack main 28872e68d3.** `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` sends `pkgBody.tagline` from `m.tagline` (around :547) and sends no `tags`.

## Work

1. Send the manifest's `tags` as `pkgBody.tags`, an array of strings, when the manifest declares them. Pre-check the cloud bounds locally only if the check uses the same numbers; otherwise let the 400 speak. Print the server's refusal message as is.
2. In #27325's warning, drop `tags` from the "not carried" list. Reword `publisher` and `isStarter` as "decided by the platform; an author's value has no effect". `preview` is unchanged.
3. Top-level `tagline`: when no `--description` flag and no manifest `description` are given, send it as `description`. Otherwise stop sending it. The per-locale `translations.*.tagline` path is unchanged.
4. Tests: tags are sent; the reworded warning; the tagline-to-description mapping in both cases. Include an ablation.

## Done when

`os package publish` of a manifest that declares `tags` leaves them in the hosted `sys_package.tags`, and the warning no longer names `tags`.

## Reader

Triage routes this card. It is objectstack-only (CLI), so no cloud work remains.
